subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 8: Perimeter of Composite Figures
description: Find the perimeter of composite figures by tracing the outside boundary, finding missing side lengths, and adding all outer sides.
learningObjectives: Trace the outside boundary of a composite figure
Identify which side lengths are part of the perimeter
Find missing side lengths by matching horizontal and vertical totals
Add all outside side lengths to find perimeter
Explain and correct common perimeter mistakes
prerequisites: Understand perimeter as distance around a figure
Use opposite sides of rectangles to find missing lengths
Distinguish linear units from square units
